name: Prefix sums + hash
summary: Turn 'sum/count of subarrays' into a difference of two prefix values.

name: Monotonic stack
summary: Nearest greater/smaller element on either side in one pass.

name: Two pointers on sorted data
summary: Shrink a pair search from O(n²) to O(n) using sorted order.

name: Sliding window
summary: Longest/shortest contiguous window satisfying a monotone condition.

name: Binary search on the answer
summary: When 'can we do it with X?' is monotone in X, search X.

name: BFS shortest path
summary: Unweighted shortest distance, layer by layer; multi-source when many starts.

name: DFS + backtracking
summary: Enumerate choices, undo on return; prune early.

name: Union-find
summary: Dynamic connectivity and grouping with near-O(1) merges.

name: Topological sort
summary: Order tasks under prerequisites; detect cycles.

name: Dijkstra
summary: Shortest path with non-negative weights via a min-heap.

name: Heap / top-k
summary: Keep the k best seen so far; merge streams.

name: Intervals
summary: Sort by start; sweep with the current end or a heap of ends.

name: 1-D DP
summary: State = position (and one small extra); answer builds left to right.

name: Grid / 2-D DP
summary: State = (i, j); transitions from neighbours or from two strings' prefixes.

name: Knapsack-style DP
summary: Choose items under a capacity; reachability of sums.

name: DP on intervals
summary: dp[l][r] from splitting at k; last-removed element trick.

name: Bitmask DP
summary: State = set of visited/used items when n ≤ ~20.

name: Trie
summary: Prefix tree for many-word lookups and prefix matching.

name: Linked list pointers
summary: Slow/fast pointers, reversal in place, dummy head.

name: Trees: recursion that returns
summary: Each call returns a small summary of its subtree; combine at the parent.

name: Greedy + sort
summary: Sort by the right key, then take locally best; prove with exchange argument.

name: Fenwick / segment tree
summary: Prefix queries with point updates in O(log n); offline sort + count.

name: Divide and conquer
summary: Solve halves, count cross pairs at the merge.

name: Design / hashing
summary: O(1) operations by combining a hash map with a list or linked list.

name: Math / counting
summary: Closed forms, modular arithmetic, parity, pigeonhole.
